lessons.titleEn: running just to stay in the same place
lessons.titleZh: 拼命努力卻仍原地踏步

brief.meaningEn: Working hard merely to avoid falling behind, without making real progress.
brief.meaningZh: 付出大量努力，只能避免退步，未能真正前進。
brief.grammar: Be running just to stay in the same place; the running image is figurative. Keep the contrast between effort and unchanged position.
brief.register: Everyday economic or workload discussion; a freelance editor tells a colleague why added hours have not raised savings.
brief.boundaryZh: 不是完全沒有努力，也不是普通維持現狀；要有持續付出與缺乏進展的反差。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不是實際在跑步機上運動，也不表示每項成果都毫無價值。
brief.outcomeZh: 能指出付出的努力、抵銷努力的因素及仍未改善的結果。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 173, row 7; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: Many workers feel they are running just to stay in the same place.
sources.expression: running just to stay in the same place

listening.en: The team now files twice as many forms, but new rules add the same amount of paperwork. The team is running just to stay in the same place.
listening.zh: 團隊現在提交的表格多了一倍，但新規則也增加同等工作量。團隊拼命做，卻仍原地踏步。
listening.promptZh: running just to stay in the same place 表示甚麼？

options.en: Their extra effort produces no net progress.
options.zh: 額外努力沒有帶來實質進展。

options.en: The new rules have already reduced the team’s total paperwork.
options.zh: 新規則已減少團隊的總體文書工作。

options.en: The team cleared the whole backlog by filing more forms.
options.zh: 團隊多提交表格後，清除了全部積壓工作。

options.en: The added forms were unrelated to the new rules.
options.zh: 新增表格與新規則無關。

listening.explanationZh: 提交更多表格同時新增同量工作，努力被抵銷。

reply.promptEn: Why has Kira’s savings balance not risen? She takes an extra editing shift every weekend, but the higher transport cost uses up that extra pay.
reply.promptZh: （綺拉的儲蓄為何沒有增加？她每個週末多做一更編輯工作，但交通費上升，剛好用掉額外收入。）

options.en: Her extra shift only offsets the higher cost.
options.zh: 額外更次只抵銷較高費用。

options.en: She works more without increasing savings.
options.zh: 她做得更多，儲蓄卻沒增加。

options.en: She is running just to stay in the same place.
options.zh: 她拼命努力，卻仍原地踏步。

options.en: The new pay is absorbed by travel.
options.zh: 新收入被交通費吸收。

reply.explanationZh: 四句均指出努力增加，但結果沒有進步。

scene.promptZh: 溫習組每週多練十題，但新考核範圍也每週增加十題；未完成題目數維持不變。哪句最貼切？

options.en: The study group is running just to stay in the same place.
options.zh: 溫習組拼命努力，卻仍原地踏步。

options.en: The group has now completed all of the new assessment material.
options.zh: 小組現已完成所有新增考核內容。

options.en: The unfinished total falls each week despite the new topics.
options.zh: 雖有新增課題，未完成總數仍每週下降。

scene.explanationZh: 練習量被新增題目抵銷，未完成數目沒有減少。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個情況最不符合這個比喻？

options.en: Extra sales only cover an equal increase in rent.
options.zh: 銷售增加，只能抵銷同等幅度的租金上升。

options.en: A volunteer doubles her hours and the backlog finally falls by half.
options.zh: 義工工時加倍，積壓工作終於減半。

options.en: More practice is offset by a matching growth in tasks.
options.zh: 增加的練習被同量新增任務抵銷。

contrast.explanationZh: 積壓減半是真正進展，不是原地踏步。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「這比喻代表那人根本沒付出努力。」你會怎樣回應？

options.en: Running just to stay in the same place suggests substantial effort with little net progress.
options.zh: 拼命努力卻仍原地踏步，正是有投入而進展有限。

options.en: The phrase describes people who refuse to work.
options.zh: 這片語形容拒絕工作的人。

options.en: It always describes an actual treadmill race.
options.zh: 它一定形容真的跑步機比賽。

dialogue.explanationZh: running 的意象強調努力，stay 指結果沒有明顯前進。

speaking.en: The archive digitised fifty pages each week, but new donations arrived at the same rate, so the team was running just to stay in the same place.
speaking.zh: 檔案館每週把五十頁數碼化，但新捐贈資料也以同樣速度到來，團隊拼命努力，卻仍原地踏步。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再指出哪兩個數量互相抵銷。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：小劇院每週多賣四十張票，但新的場地費剛好吃掉新增收入。財務團隊加班做宣傳，月末結餘仍不變。用英文描述努力與結果，不要說票房毫無增加。
writing.selfCheckZh: 寫出每週多賣四十張票、場地費吃掉新增收入、月末結餘不變，保留宣傳努力。

examples.en: The theatre sells forty more tickets a week, but higher venue fees absorb the extra income. Its team is running just to stay in the same place despite working longer on promotion, with no change in its month-end balance.
examples.zh: 劇院每週多賣四十張票，但較高的場地費吃掉新增收入。團隊加班宣傳，月末結餘仍不變，拼命努力卻仍原地踏步。

examples.en: After extra promotion brought in forty more ticket sales each week, the new venue charge wiped out the gain; the theatre is running just to stay in the same place, with no change in its month-end balance.
examples.zh: 增加宣傳後，劇院每週多賣四十張票，但新的場地費抵銷了收益；月末結餘不變，劇院仍在拼命努力而原地踏步。

takeaways.en: Running just to stay in the same place contrasts effort with no net progress.
takeaways.zh: 拼命努力卻仍原地踏步，強調投入與進展不足的反差。

takeaways.en: Running just to stay in the same place is less apt if the result clearly improves.
takeaways.zh: 若結果明顯改善，就較不適合用拼命努力卻仍原地踏步。

notes: AI-authored provisional draft; independent English, Chinese, media and QA review remain pending. Guide-written source provenance; newly written practice. No human or release approval is implied.

brief.meaningEn: At a markedly different level from a comparison, often much greater in scale or seriousness when context makes the direction clear.
brief.meaningZh: 與比較對象處於明顯不同層次；較高或較嚴重的方向須由語境說明。
brief.grammar: Be in a (completely) different league from/to something; league is figurative. Do not infer the direction of comparison without context.
brief.register: Everyday evaluation; a technician compares a short local outage with a region-wide failure that takes days to repair.
brief.boundaryZh: 說的是顯著層次差異，不是小小差別；它本身不必然表示「更好」，也可指更嚴重。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不一定涉及體育聯賽；須交代比較維度與方向。
brief.outcomeZh: 能指出兩個比較對象、差距在哪個維度，以及哪一個更強或更嚴重。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 177, row 4; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: Armed robbery is in a completely different league from a minor theft.

listening.en: A five-minute delay affected one train, but the signal failure stopped every line for two days. The second disruption was in a completely different league.
listening.zh: 一班列車延誤五分鐘；訊號故障卻令所有路線停駛兩天。後者造成的影響嚴重得多，屬完全不同層次。
listening.promptZh: in a completely different league 在這裏表示甚麼？

options.en: The second problem was far more severe in scale.
options.zh: 第二個問題在規模上嚴重得多。

options.en: The two problems had much the same scale of disruption.
options.zh: 兩個問題造成的中斷規模相若。

options.en: The second failure delayed only one train for five minutes.
options.zh: 第二次故障只令一班列車延誤五分鐘。

options.en: The first delay stopped all lines for two days.
options.zh: 第一次延誤令所有路線停駛兩天。

listening.explanationZh: 一班列車五分鐘與所有路線兩天的差距很大。

reply.promptEn: How do the two camera repairs compare? One needs a loose screw tightened; the other requires a completely new sensor and a week of work.
reply.promptZh: （兩項相機維修怎樣比較？一項只須鎖緊螺絲；另一項要換新感應器，並花一星期。）

options.en: The sensor repair is much more involved.
options.zh: 更換感應器複雜得多。

options.en: The jobs differ greatly in effort and time.
options.zh: 兩項工作的工序和時間差距很大。

options.en: The sensor repair is in a different league from the screw fix.
options.zh: 更換感應器與鎖緊螺絲相比，是另一個層次的維修。

options.en: The week-long job is not comparable to the quick fix in scale.
options.zh: 這項花一星期的工作，在規模上不能與快速修理相比。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都指出維修規模的明顯差距。

scene.promptZh: 甲展覽只用一個展櫃，乙展覽要用整幢館舍及二十名導賞員。若比較所需資源，哪句最貼切？

options.en: The second exhibition is in a different league.
options.zh: 第二個展覽所需資源高出一個層次。

options.en: Both exhibitions need the same number of staff and rooms.
options.zh: 兩個展覽所需人手與房間數相同。

options.en: The larger exhibition requires only one display case.
options.zh: 較大型展覽只需一個展櫃。

scene.explanationZh: 場地與人手需求有明顯層次差別。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個比較最不足以說 in a different league？

options.en: A one-hour translation versus a six-month multilingual project.
options.zh: 一小時翻譯與六個月多語計劃。

options.en: Two nearly identical pens differing only in cap colour.
options.zh: 兩支幾乎一樣、只差筆蓋顏色的筆。

options.en: A local power flicker versus a citywide outage lasting days.
options.zh: 本地瞬間停電與持續數天的全城大停電。

contrast.explanationZh: 只有筆蓋顏色的小差別，不支持層次懸殊。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「different league 一定讚美後者更好。」你怎樣回應？

options.en: Being in a different league can mean much worse or more serious; context gives the direction.
options.zh: 處於不同層次也可指更糟或更嚴重；方向要看語境。

options.en: It can only mean athletic excellence.
options.zh: 它只能指運動表現出色。

options.en: It always says the two are equal.
options.zh: 它一定表示兩者相等。

dialogue.explanationZh: 此例的差距可在嚴重程度，而非品質優劣。

speaking.en: A small typo is inconvenient, but losing the whole archive is in a completely different league of seriousness.
speaking.zh: 一個小錯字會帶來不便，但遺失整個檔案庫的嚴重程度完全不同。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再指出哪件事更嚴重。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：學校昨天一間課室停電十分鐘；今日電力故障令整座校舍停課兩天。用英文比較兩次故障的影響，不要誤說昨天也停課兩天。
writing.selfCheckZh: 寫出昨天一間課室停電十分鐘、今天全校停課兩天、後者嚴重得多。

examples.en: Yesterday one classroom lost power for ten minutes; today an electrical failure has closed the whole school for two days. The second failure is in a completely different league in scale.
examples.zh: 昨天一間課室停電十分鐘；今日電力故障令整間學校停課兩天。後者在影響規模上完全不同。

examples.en: Compared with yesterday’s ten-minute outage in one room, today’s electrical failure has closed the entire school for two days and is in a different league of seriousness.
examples.zh: 與昨天一間課室停電十分鐘相比，今日電力故障令整座校舍停課兩天，嚴重程度高出一個層次。

takeaways.en: In a different league marks a large difference in level.
takeaways.zh: 處於不同層次，指層次差距很大。

takeaways.en: Being in a different league need not mean better; state the dimension and direction.
takeaways.zh: 處於不同層次不一定代表更好；須交代比較維度和方向。
